descriptions.biomart: Ensembl BioMart — genomic annotations, identifier translation, and cross-reference queries.
descriptions.pubmed: PubMed biomedical literature — search, metadata, abstracts, full-text (PMC), related articles, ID conversion, copyright status, citation lookup.
descriptions.clinical-trials: ClinicalTrials.gov — trial search, details, endpoints, sponsor/investigator/eligibility queries.
descriptions.chembl: ChEMBL bioactivity database — compound/drug/target search, bioactivities, mechanisms, ADMET.
descriptions.biorxiv: bioRxiv/medRxiv preprints — search, metadata, published links, funder search, usage statistics.
descriptions.variants: Human genetic variants — gnomAD population frequencies/constraint (r4), ClinVar records/search (direct NCBI), dbSNP, structural and mitochondrial variants.
descriptions.clinical-genomics: Clinical genomics knowledge — ClinGen gene validity, dosage and actionability curations plus CIViC clinical evidence.
descriptions.expression: Gene expression — GTEx tissue expression and eQTLs (pinned dataset).
descriptions.regulation: Gene regulation — ENCODE experiments/files/biosamples, JASPAR transcription-factor binding matrices, UniBind TFBS.
descriptions.protein-annotation: Protein annotation — InterPro/Pfam domains and families, Human Protein Atlas, STRING interaction networks.
descriptions.rna: Non-coding RNA — Rfam families, seed alignments, covariance models, trees, sequence regions.
descriptions.structures-interactions: Structures and molecular interactions — PDB structures, AlphaFold predictions, EMDB cryo-EM entries, Complex Portal complexes, IntAct interaction networks.
descriptions.omics-archives: Omics data archives — ArrayExpress/BioStudies, GEO, MGnify, PRIDE proteomics projects.
descriptions.genes-ontologies: Gene identity and ontologies — MyGene queries, OLS4 ontology terms, GO annotations (QuickGO), UniProt entries, Reactome pathways.
descriptions.drug-regulatory: FDA drug data — Drugs@FDA applications, approvals, pharmacologic classes, generic equivalents, SPL drug labels.
descriptions.research-resources: Research resources — Grants.gov funding opportunity search, Antibody Registry lookups.
descriptions.x-science-research: Independent X-Science research MCP — compact discovery and bounded execution of an operator-verified research capability pack without exposing each source as a separate Skill.
descriptions.cancer-models: Cancer genomics cohorts — cBioPortal studies, mutations, copy-number alterations, clinical attributes.
descriptions.chemistry: Small-molecule chemistry — PubChem compounds/properties/similarity, ChEBI ontology, Rhea reactions, BindingDB affinities.
descriptions.human-genetics: Human genetics associations — GWAS Catalog, eQTL Catalogue, FinnGen/BioBank-Japan PheWAS portals.
descriptions.literature: Scholarly literature graph — OpenAlex works/authors/venues/citations, arXiv metadata.
descriptions.genomes: Genome annotation — Ensembl REST lookup/sequence/homology/VEP, UCSC Genome Browser tracks and conservation.
descriptions.cellguide: Cell type information from CELLxGENE — descriptions, marker genes, tissue distribution, source datasets.
descriptions.zinc: ZINC22 purchasable chemical space (CartBlanche22) — compound lookup by ZINC id, SMILES exact/similarity search, supplier-code resolution, random sampling, 3D structure locations for docking.
descriptions.omtx-om: Official hosted Om MCP — target-conditioned small-molecule ranking with LULA, accessible-space screening, molecule fulfillment, generated-data access and discovery diligence without local model deployment.
descriptions.patsnap-chemical-molecular: Official hosted PatSnap Chemical Molecular MCP — structure and similarity search, fragment and scaffold analysis, ADMET prediction, patent-linked compound intelligence and SAR extraction.
descriptions.inductive-bio: Official hosted Inductive Bio MCP — small-molecule ADMET and PK property prediction for solubility, permeability, stability, efflux, CYP, hERG, BBB and related development risks without local model deployment.
descriptions.boltz-api-official: Official hosted Boltz MCP — small-molecule and protein structure or binding prediction, library screening, binder design and ADME workflows without local model deployment.
descriptions.open-targets-official: Official hosted Open Targets Platform MCP — target/disease evidence, tractability, safety, genetics, drug mechanisms and clinical candidates through schema-guided GraphQL.
descriptions.tamarind-bio: Hosted computational drug-design MCP — molecular and protein structure prediction, docking, protein/antibody/RNA design, molecular generation and property workflows without local GPU deployment.
descriptions.adaptyv-cloud-lab: Official hosted cloud-lab MCP for protein and antibody validation — target catalog, experiment design, quotes, binding/affinity, expression, thermostability and structured results.
descriptions.ketcher-chemistry: Interactive 2D molecule sketcher (Ketcher) as an MCP App. Backs the .ket/.smi/.mol/.sdf/.rxn artifact viewer.
